instrument: Box Elder County Commission approval, Stratos (O'Leary Digital)
summary: Box Elder County commissioners approved the Stratos data center project unanimously on May 4, 2026. The site is unincorporated land in Hansel Valley north of the Great Salt Lake, near Snowville.
notes: Original proposal reported at roughly 40,000 acres and 7.5 to 9 GW.
confidence_note: Relayed; the commission record has not been read.

source.citation: Utah news coverage, June 2026; Salt Lake Tribune, Deseret News and KSL reporting on the Stratos project
